name: hoba-monorepo
description: Hiring Obstacles & Barriers Atlas — canonical repo for hoba.work
author: Dmytro Yemelianov <dmytro@hoba.work>

scripts.build: pnpm build:packages && pnpm build:registry && pnpm build:discovery && pnpm --filter hoba-site build && pnpm build:cards
scripts.build:packages: tsc -b packages/registry packages/cli packages/mcp && chmod +x packages/cli/dist/cli.js packages/mcp/dist/index.js
scripts.clean: rimraf node_modules packages/*/dist packages/*/node_modules packages/*/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo site/.astro site/dist site/node_modules
scripts.deploy:pages: pnpm build && wrangler pages deploy site/dist --project-name hoba-work --branch main
scripts.deploy:preview: pnpm build && wrangler pages deploy site/dist --project-name hoba-work --branch "$(git branch --show-current)"
scripts.lean: pnpm build:lean && cd formal && lake build
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -b packages/registry packages/cli packages/mcp --dry
